verdict.rationale: Firebase documents an official MCP server that works with any MCP client, including Claude Code/Desktop, Cursor, VS Code Copilot, Cline and Windsurf. It lets agents create and manage projects, manage Auth users, and work with Firestore and SQL Connect data, and a probe confirms the official docs page exists. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of the server working in practice, and evidence of setup/authentication details and the full tool coverage.
